_purpose: Every parameter of the within-take rhythmic-monotony gate (D-SSM-31 axis 1), each with its evidence. NO value in music_studio/rhythm_monotony.py is set by an agent's judgement: the module refuses to run if a key is missing here (CLAUSE 4 / the 2026-08-16 standing order: maximally parametric, no static values in code).

frame_seconds._evidence: Shared with the axis-2 instrument (data/take_similarity.json chroma block, Serra NJP 2009 primary): one chroma geometry across both gates so their features are comparable — two lists that must agree, kept in agreement by a shared convention recorded in both files.

feature_smoothing_length._evidence: MEASURED this session from the installed reference implementation: libfmp 1.3.0 compute_sm_from_filename signature carries L=21 as the feature-smoothing default of the published SM pipeline. OMITTING this stage was a measured defect (2026-08-17 14:1x): without smoothing+downsampling a 270 s take produced a ~1150-frame scape-plot input and the first LM-SSD run sat >14 minutes on one take — the stage is part of the reference chain, not an optimisation.

feature_downsampling._evidence: Same measured reference signature: H=5 (downsampling factor of the smoothed feature sequence). The SI band conversion accounts for the coarser frame period explicitly.

timescale_bands_seconds._evidence: Wu & Yang ICASSP 2023 (arXiv:2209.08212, read [FULL] 2026-08-17, capture archived): their 2023 bands 4-12 / 12-32 / >32 s. Contradiction C3 in the research report records that the same authors used 3/8/15 s in 2020 — proof the bands are CORPUS-TUNED DATA. These values are therefore the CALIBRATION STARTING GRID, never the shipped constant; the calibrated bar artefact supersedes them per genre bucket (Clause 23).

smoothing_filter_length._evidence: MEASURED this session from the installed reference implementation itself: libfmp 1.3.0 (MIT, the method authors' own package) compute_sm_from_filename signature carries L_smooth=16 as its published pipeline default (inspect.signature output archived in the session log). The first parameter-file draft claimed 41 from a notebook recollection — corrected to the measured value the same turn.

tempo_relative_set._evidence: Same measured reference signature: tempo_rel_set=array([1]) is the pipeline default. Widening the set is a calibration-time decision to make against labelled takes, never a shipped guess.

threshold._evidence: Same measured reference signature: strategy='relative', thresh=0.15, scale=True.

penalty._evidence: Same measured reference signature: penalty=0.0 is the reference pipeline default. The first draft claimed -2.0 from a notebook recollection — corrected to the measured value the same turn; a penalty sweep belongs to calibration, not to code.

bpm_min._evidence: Grosche/Mueller/Kurth ICASSP 2010 (read [FULL] 2026-08-17, capture archived): tempo axis range 30-480 BPM for the Fourier tempogram before octave folding.

novelty_window_seconds._evidence: Same primary: 6 s Hann window over the spectral-flux novelty curve.

single_bar_consecutive_limit._evidence: Wu & Yang (arXiv:2209.08212 section 5, read [FULL]): 'one bar of melody being exactly and consecutively repeated over 6 times' — measured 5.5% of their un-pretrained generations vs 0.5% of real data. The audio transfer defines 'exactly repeated' by the PUBLISHED Haitsma-Kalker near-exact criterion (BER below the 0.35 operating point), consumed BY IMPORT from take_similarity.near_copy_ber_threshold() — never retyped here (single source of truth). The first draft used a self-referencing similarity quantile invented by the agent; the control suite caught it degenerating on the all-identical case and it was replaced the same turn.

neighbour_pair_consecutive_limit._evidence: Same primary, same sentence: 'or two neighboring bars repeated over 4 times'.

bar_source._evidence: Research report axis-3 committed recommendation: SI band values from the primary are SYMBOLIC-origin and do not transfer to Lyria audio (Honest limits section) — the SI fail bar and the tempogram-stability bar are calibrated locally on labelled monotone/varied takes via music_studio/bar_calibration.py (logit + exact noncentral-t upper tolerance limit).

status_until_calibrated._evidence: MANDATE CLAUSE 7: a threshold is never guessed; the gate reports NOT_CALIBRATED with raw statistics until the bar artefact exists.

limits_read_this_first.genre_constraint: Beat-tracker-dependent statistics are pop-only (research F8: madmom-class baselines F1 0.473-0.595 on expressive material). This gate therefore uses FIXED-WINDOW chroma frames and the continuous Fourier tempogram — no beat decisions anywhere — so it stays valid on ballad/cinematic takes.
limits_read_this_first.si_absolute_values: The published SI numbers (83.6/43.8/32.5) prove the SEPARATION DIRECTION only; the absolute values come from symbolic-origin renditions and are never used as a bar.
